title: LEI replay fires for types behind the client's last-seen state
description: In events_handler LEI replay logic (around line 228), the condition 'current_state == *lei' only suppresses replay when the type's state exactly matches the LEI. If a type's current state is numerically lower (e.g. Contact at s-3, LEI=s-5), the mismatch triggers a replay of the stale s-3 state. The client then calls Contact/changes?sinceState=s-3 and receives changes it has already processed. Not data loss, but causes spurious round-trips and could confuse clients that interpret the replay as 'you missed this'. The comparison should test whether current_state is newer than the LEI, not merely different from it.
